definitions.explanation: A restaurant or shop that specializes in serving sushi.

examples.japanese: {駅|えき}の{近|ちか}くに{寿司屋|すしや}がある。
examples.english: There is a sushi restaurant near the station.

examples.japanese: {誕生日|たんじょうび}に{高級|こうきゅう}{寿司屋|すしや}で{食|た}べた。
examples.english: I ate at a high-end sushi restaurant on my birthday.

examples.japanese: あの{寿司屋|すしや}は{予約|よやく}が{取|と}りにくいほど{人気|にんき}がある。
examples.english: That sushi restaurant is so popular that it's hard to get a reservation.

notes:
{寿司屋|すしや} specifically refers to restaurants that specialize in sushi.

WORD FORMATION:
{寿司|すし} (sushi) + {屋|や} (shop/restaurant suffix)

TYPES OF SUSHI RESTAURANTS:
- {回転|かいてん}{寿司|ずし}: conveyor belt sushi (casual, affordable)
- {高級|こうきゅう}{寿司屋|すしや}: high-end sushi restaurant (often with a counter)
- {立|た}ち{食|ぐ}い{寿司|ずし}: standing sushi bar (quick, informal)

CULTURAL NOTE:
At traditional {寿司屋|すしや}, customers sit at a counter ({カウンター}) facing the {板前|いたまえ} (sushi chef). Ordering おまかせ (chef's choice) is common at higher-end establishments.

THE {屋|や} SUFFIX:
The same pattern forms many shop/restaurant names: {魚屋|さかなや} (fish shop), {花屋|はなや} (flower shop), {肉屋|にくや} (butcher).
